sections.section_title: Addition, Subtraction and Simplification of Algebraic Fractions

sections.content_markdown:
| Arithmetic | Algebra |
| :--- | :--- |
| If the whole square region is taken as 1, then its black coloured part | If the whole square region is taken as $x$, then its black coloured part |
| $= \frac{2}{4}$ of $1 = \frac{2}{4}$ | $= \frac{2}{4}$ of $x = \frac{2x}{4}$ |
| Line drawn part $= \frac{1}{4}$ of $1 = \frac{1}{4}$ | Line-drawn part $= \frac{1}{4}$ of $x = \frac{x}{4}$ |
| $\therefore$ Total coloured part $= \frac{2}{4} + \frac{1}{4}$ | $\therefore$ Total coloured part $= \frac{2x}{4} + \frac{x}{4}$ |
| (Black and line drawn) $= \frac{2+1}{4} = \frac{3}{4}$ | (Black and line drawn) $= \frac{2x+x}{4} = \frac{3x}{4}$ |
| $\therefore$ White part $= \left(1 - \frac{3}{4}\right) = \frac{4-3}{4} = \frac{1}{4}$ | $\therefore$ White part $= x - \frac{3x}{4} = \frac{4x}{4} - \frac{3x}{4}$ |
| | $= \frac{4x-3x}{4} = \frac{x}{4}$ |
We observe, the fractions written into above boxes have been made into common denominators in case of addition and subtraction .

sections.section_title: Rules for addition and subtraction of algebraic fractions
sections.content_markdown:
- Make the fractions to their lowest common denominator.
- Denominator of the sum will be the lowest common denominator and the numerator will be the sum of the numerators of the transformed fractions.
- Denominator of the difference will be the lowest common denominator and numerator will be the difference of the numerators of the transformed fractions.
